verdict.rationale: AWS docs show building blocks that support isolation-style guardrails — IAM roles/policies/permissions boundaries for restricting scope, IAM role assumption for temporary least-privilege credentials, and Budgets that can auto-apply a deny policy to stop further provisioning — plus a Free Tier account for safe experimentation. However, none of the evidence directly documents AWS Organizations, Organizational Units, Control Tower guardrails, or sandbox-account patterns that the story specifically asks about (multi-account/project isolation for experiments vs prod). missing for 10: AWS Organizations/OU docs, Control Tower guardrails, dedicated sandbox-account pattern documentation, independent corroboration that these prevent prod impact.
